paper_title: Laboratory Constraints on the Neutron-Spin Coupling of feV-scale Axions
coupling_convention: g_an (dimensionless), canonical AxionNeutron coupling to neutron spin
notes: Paper reports median 95% upper limit of g_aNN < 2.4×10^-10 GeV^-1 for axion masses from 0.4 to 4 feV (0.4e-15 to 4e-15 eV). The coupling is stated in the paper as g_aNN in GeV^-1. The paper assumes axions make up all local dark matter (ρ_DM ≈ 0.3 GeV/cm^3 standard halo model). The limit is mass-independent over the stated range 0.4–4 feV, encoded as a horizontal line. The experiment is a K-3He co-magnetometer searching for neutron-spin coupling via stochastic dark matter axion signals. The analysis properly accounts for stochasticity using frequency-domain likelihood formalism. Multiple peaks in the power spectrum were investigated but rejected as non-axion origin via lineshape analysis and seasonal consistency checks.
